hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The candidate anagram length k must evenly divide the total length of the string.

hints.title: Testing Divisors
hints.text: Iterate through possible divisor lengths k in strictly increasing order.

hints.title: Block Comparison
hints.text: For each candidate k, check if every consecutive block of size k has identical character frequencies to the first block. Return the first valid k.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: d(n): number of divisors of n
complexity.notes: Testing at most small count of divisors with 26-character frequency arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing non-divisors or arbitrary anagram substrings takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for fixed 26-element counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Iterate over integer divisors and verify frequency equality across all consecutive chunks.
